Coyote Sight.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

DeltaPoint Sight.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

Kousaku Sight.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

OKP-7.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

Kousaku OLED Sight.info: A OLED display built into a reflex sight. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

Z-Point.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

MACRO P-1.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

Comp Aimpoint.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

EOTech XPS2.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

Delta Sight.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

UH Gen1.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

EOTech 552.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

Microdot SRS.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

Reflex Sight.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

Kobra EKP Sight.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

Microdot Mini.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

DCL 120.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

Kobra Sight.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

DDHB Reflex.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

Mini Sight.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

Barska Electro.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

Pilad 3.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

MARS.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

EOTech M40.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

PKA-S.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.
